notes.title: The Sentries and Drones Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/98e55e49d47501e2b61501a7eb99c0d837d82ec3.png[/img]

[h1]Minigunner Build 0.8.9.6 Patch Notes[/h1]

This long anticipated update brings a [b]huge new shipment[/b] of robotic companions to the shop. Each sentry and drone has [b]unique strengths[/b] that can turn the tide of battle in your runs! 

Need more [b]single target[/b] damage for boss fights? Why not pick up a [b]Marksman sentry[/b] or [b]Scattershot sentry[/b]! Need more [b]AoE[/b] for large groups of enemies? Use a [b]Flamethrower drone[/b] or a [b]Frostbomb sentry[/b] to control those crowds! With so many options to choose from, there's a sentry or drone for every situation!

We've also given some tender care and love to some of the Engineer's items, with a rework to the [b]Experimental micro-rockets[/b] and a ton of exciting improvements to some of his [b]legendaries[/b], he is going to be eating good this update!

Changes with the '📡 '  icon in front of them are changes or additions suggested by the community!

[h2]General[/h2]
-Standardized the way we describe the player's health, will now be stated as 0.5 instead of 1/2

-We’ve made a handful of optimizations to improve performance across the board- especially in the Abyssal Warden boss fight!

-Added new loading screen tips relating to our new sentries and drones

-Added a whole new batch of SFX to the Minigunner and quite a few of his items!

-Improved sentry and drone damage tracking that is displayed in the equipment page of the TAB screen, will now take into account item effects like micro rocket explosions.

-Added muzzle flashes to the attacks of sentries and drones

-Added and improved VFX for many item effects including critical hits, flame trails, damage numbers, and more!

-Improvements made to ally pathing, drones should move much smoother now

-📡 Small and Large First Aids now display how much they can heal for before you buy them from the shop

-📡 Brigade beamers can now notice and seek out enemies that are around walls or behind cover

-📡 All allied drones can now freely path over low walls and through highground platforms
[i](they will no longer take the scenic route anymore!)[/i]

[h2]Sentries & Drones[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/ee6642d476546b6409d4e439722d7e79615db6c5.png[/img]
-[b]NEW:[/b] The Marksman Sentry 
⚙️90 scrap
[i]This sentry has exceptionally long range! Place it on a far away sentry spot and let it snipe away at the toughest enemies. Its projectiles gain more damage the further they travel![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Scattershot Sentry
⚙️90 scrap
[i]This close range sentry gun has a reduced targeting radius but makes up for it with devastating bursts of damage![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Frostbomb Sentry
⚙️100 scrap
[i]This sentry excels into big groups of enemies, it fires high-tech frost bombs that explode on contact, damaging and slowing all enemies hit![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Assault Drone
⚙️160 scrap
[i]This heavy duty drone has slower movement and turn speed, but cranks out a barrage of bullets towards any foes that get within its sights![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Missile Drone
⚙️120 scrap
[i]This versatile drone fires homing rockets that lock onto nearby enemies, exploding on contact and damaging nearby targets![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Flamethrower Drone
⚙️170 scrap
[i]This spicy drone will engulf enemies in scorching flames, extremely effective when enemies are clustered together![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Scrap Recovery Drone
⚙️30 scrap
[i]This helpful drone will attempt to recover scrap that has despawned. A scrap deposit isn't truly lost until all available scrap recovery drones have tried to salvage it![/i]


-[b]NEW:[/b] The Surveillance Drone
⚙️30 scrap
[i]This watchful drone will seek out high health targets and scan them. Once the scan is complete they are marked to [b]QUINTUPLE[/b] the next damage they take![/i]


-Attack Drone
Scrap price increased ⚙️75 scrap -> ⚙️80 scrap

-Compound Sentry
Damage per second increased by +14%

-Fortress Sentry [i](Forge Hammer Upgrade)[/i]
Damage per second increased by +24%
[i]Out of all Forge Hammer upgraded sentries, the Fortress Sentry (Formerly LVL 3 Sentry) is now the undisputed king of DPS, with the 60 scrap upgrade cost being 300% efficient on it now![/i]

-Compound Mini-Sentry
Damage per second increased by +25%

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Experimental Micro-Rockets
[b]OLD:[/b] Your sentries gain a chance to fire a homing rocket instead of a normal projectile
[b]NEW:[/b] Your sentries gain a chance on hit to release a cluster of 3 homing rockets that seek nearby enemies

-Luminescent Prism
Stun time increased 0.5 seconds -> 1.5 seconds

-Forge Hammer
Improved the value of various forged sentry upgrades
Added [b]3 new sentry upgrades[/b]:[list]
[*]Marksman Sentry -> Sharpshooter Sentry
[*]Scattershot Sentry -> Scatterburst Sentry
[*]Frostbomb Sentry -> Frostnova Sentry[/list]-E40 Prototype Rounds
Electric explosion damage increased 10 -> 30
Stunning electric explosion stun duration increased 1 second -> 3 seconds

[h2]New General Items[/h2] 
[i](spoilered for your protection)[/i]

[b]Common Tier[/b]
-Helpful Transmitter
[spoiler]Use the shop's random item option to discount your next sentry or drone purchase [/spoiler]
[b]UNLOCKED WITH NEW ACHIEVEMENT: The House Always Wins[/b]
[i]Reach and complete wave 16 without using the shop's random item option[/i]

[b]Rare Tier[/b]
-Crystal Fruit
[spoiler]Increase your max HP (This item cannot be found in shops or rare item crates!)[/spoiler]
[i]Unlocked by default![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/44521d71e2e38f71718f4a34353d6035f0d138eb.png[/img][i]A helpful transmission has been received![/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
If you want to report bugs or give feedback, join our [b][u][url=https://discord.gg/K7tfWk48qQ]Discord![/url][/u][/b]
If you want to check on the status of reported bugs, check out our [b][u][url=https://trello.com/b/1vwopl3b]Bug Tracker![/url][/u][/b]

These bugs have been squashed!

-Fixed a visual issue with the E40 Prototype Rounds' particle trails

-Fixed issue (from the Commando Update) that prevented the Antique Speedloader from stacking

-Fixed an issue where you could get the frostbite debuff from the Frostblaster’s attacks before they actually go off

-Fixed issue where the TAB Map would show an incoming wave beyond the end of the game after winning (Wave 17 / 21)

-Fixed a bug where the gold ability border persisted after scrapping or trading the gilded anvil as Engineer

-Fixed an issue where the Giga-Beamer could very rarely fire an attack during its death animation

-Resolved an issue allowing you to acquire more stacks than intended for items

-Fixed a bug where you could use your movement skill while inside a vent

-Fixed an issue where damage to bosses with the burst rifle did not count towards charging the Military Munitions

-Fixed an issue where relocating a sentry could have an unexpected impact on its firerate

-Fixed issue where the Combat Jetpack's particle trails could get twisted up

notes.title: The Commando Update
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.8.9.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

This update brings the highly anticipated fourth playable character to the game: [b][i]The Commando[/i][/b]! Armed to the teeth, he has the tools for any situation! Mow your enemies down with laser fire or clear a path with sheer explosive force. Learn more about him in the patch notes below! 

This update also includes a pretty big shift in the game's difficulty levels, making the game easier and faster for new players! Lastly we also have a TON of new achievements to unlock the Commando's shiny new class items, some of which are easily our new favorites in the whole game.

Changes with the '📡 '  icon in front of them are changes or additions suggested by the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/07111bbe54f8549651a086abab55f81e7c5b0f5e.png[/img][i]Unleash your potential with the Commando's impressive arsenal![/i]

[h2]General[/h2]
-New Mercenary: The Commando

-Updated Difficulty tiers to better distribute challenge, and make the game more accessible to new players. See the full mode descriptions below:

[b]-Easy Mode:[/b]
Starting HP: 5 (Previously 4)
Medical Item Prices: -50% (Unchanged)
Enemy HP: -35% (Unchanged)
Total Waves: 16 (Previously 20)
Boss Fights: 3 (Previously 4)
Limited Achievement Progression (Unchanged)

[b]-Normal Mode:[/b]
Starting HP: 4 (Previously 3)
Total Waves: 16 (Previously 20)
Boss Fights: 3 (Previously 4)

[b]-Hard Mode:[/b]
Starting HP: 3 (Previously 2)
Total Waves: 20 (Unchanged)
Boss Fights: 4 (Unchanged)
REMOVED: Enemy HP: +20%
REMOVED: Barricades Destroyed 4 waves early
REMOVED: Shops are Closed every other wave

[b]COMING SOON![/b]
[i]You've got a bad feeling about this...[/i]
In hard mode, you'll have the option to enable additional custom wave modifiers that add extra challenge (and score!) to your runs. Push yourself to the absolute limit to see how many you can overcome! Watch this space for more info when it drops in the next major update!
[i]Developer Thoughts: This is the first half of a greater difficulty options rework that we've been planning for a long time now. Our goals are to make the game easier to pick up at the start, while also giving options to add more challenge for our veteran players. The "Normal mode" that the game has been using up until this point is now the baseline for our new "Hard mode", with the spicy new wave modifiers arriving in the upcoming FINAL BOSS UPDATE. 
[/i]
-The player's rotation will now update correctly if you move your cursor while combat rolling

-📡 Added a "shoot when aiming" option for gamepad controllers

-📡 The Tab Screen has a new timer that will show the duration of the current run

-📡 The time stat in the post game screen will now show new records for successful runs with the fastest times 

[h2]The Commando[/h2]
This new mercenary relishes every moment in battle, blasting and blowing up anything in his way! Wielding[b] TWO primary weapons[/b] that each have a unique ability tied to them, he has the tools to deal with any situation. To play him most effectively, you'll want to make the most out of his passive, using your abilities often to switch weapons and gain massive amounts of [b]adrenaline[/b]. The closer you are to the enemies you're fighting, the more adrenaline you'll gain per hit!

-Weapon: [b]Burst Rifle[/b]
Fires 3 round-bursts of laser projectiles that travel a long distance. The first shot in each burst is perfectly accurate!

-Weapon: [b]Rocket Launcher[/b]
Fires powerful rocket projectiles that explode on contact. Most effective against enemies that are clumped together.

-Ability: [b]Suppressive Fire[/b]
Rapidly fire [b]laser rounds[/b] that damage and [b]stun[/b] all enemies hit.

-Ability: [b]Rocket Barrage[/b]
Unleash a barrage of [b]swarm rockets[/b] that damage and [b]slow[/b] all enemies hit.

-Passive: [b]One Man Army[/b]
Using your ability will cause you to [b]switch to your other weapon[/b] and will consume all [b]extra ability charges[/b] you have to deal bonus ability damage.

Additionally, you can fill an [b]adrenaline meter[/b] by landing hits on enemies, When you fill the meter, you [b]double your TOTAL firerate[/b] for a short duration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/b01dcb9027e6ce31f29e45a916ed590e5f1cdf4f.png[/img][i]Feel the rush![/i]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[b]PSA: [/b]Because of the maximum achievement limit that Steam imposes being capped at 100, only a few of these achievements will be reflected on Steam, but rest assured that all your progress will continue to act like normal in game. Steam notified us that once we reach a certain threshold of player numbers, they will uncap this limit, and Steam will automatically update to reflect any progress you've made in game the next time you launch.

[b]-LOCKED AND LOADED[/b]
Defeat the Elder Spitter, Giga-Beamer, and Frostblaster
[i]Unlocks: Commando[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: MILESTONE 1[/b]
Complete Wave 8 as Commando
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Plasma Grenades[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: MILESTONE 2[/b]
Complete Wave 12 as Commando
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Tactical Scouter[/spoiler] (Commando Rare Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: MILESTONE 3[/b]
Complete Wave 16 as Commando
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Artillery Satellite[/spoiler] (Commando Legendary Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: PRIMARY DIRECTIVE[/b]
As Commando, defeat 500 enemies total across all runs
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Special Delivery[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: SECONDARY DIRECTIVE[/b]
As Commando, hit 20 different enemies with a single rocket barrage
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Battle Mortar[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: TERTIARY DIRECTIVE[/b]
As Commando, use the all-in-one foodmart 5 times in a single run
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Canned Peaches[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: FEELING THE RUSH[/b]
As Commando, fully fill your adrenaline bar in less than 20 seconds
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Adrenaline Booster[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: FASTER THAN RELOADING[/b]
As Commando, use your ability while you're out of ammo 3 consecutive times
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Trusty Sidearm[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: WE HAVE LIFT OFF[/b]
As Commando, fire off at least 50 rockets in a single rocket barrage
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Rocket Fuel[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: LEAD THE CHARGE![/b]
As Commando, deal at least 50,000 damage during a single adrenaline rush
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Tattered Flag[/spoiler] (Commando Common Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: ARMY SURPLUS[/b]
As Commando, hold 10 unique military grade items at the same time
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Military Munitions[/spoiler] (Commando Rare Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: TARGET LOCKED[/b]
As Commando, hit a single enemy with every shot from suppressive fire
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]ARH Guidance System[/spoiler] (Commando Rare Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: TACTICAL SWEEP[/b]
As Commando, access 10 keycard locked rooms in a single run
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Holo Sight[/spoiler] (Commando Rare Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: ONE MAN ARMY[/b]
As Commando, defeat 10,000 enemies total across all runs
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Phoenix Rockets[/spoiler] (Commando Legendary Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: TIME FLIES...[/b]
As Commando, complete the first 8 waves in less than 20 minutes
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Combat Jetpack[/spoiler] (Commando Legendary Item)[/i]

[b]-COMMANDO: THE ULTIMATE SHOWDOWN[/b]
As Commando, defeat the Abyssal Warden in hard mode
[i]Unlocks: [spoiler]Supply Signals[/spoiler] (Commando Legendary Item)[/i]

[h2]Sentries & Drones[/h2]
-Attack Drone
Attack drones will now prioritize targeting enemies that are closest to the player
Attack drones can now fire at enemies from slightly further away

[h2]Items[/h2]
-📡 Reactor Items (Critical Mass, Reactive Electro-Goo, Industrial Capacitor, Service Radio, Core Crystals, and Unstable Isotope)
To improve the quality of early game shops, reactor items will only start showing up after the first threat level is complete.
[i]To get value out of many of these items, your reactor will need to be under attack often, and since that does not really happen in the first few waves, these items felt like dead weight early on. We've been playtesting this change a lot and it feels great, shops now show you much better options in the early game.[/i]

-Heavy Caliber Rounds
Weapon explosions will now also benefit from the Heavy Cal Rounds' size increase!

-Rusty Magnet
Fixed the item panel showing as blank

-Winchester Shells
Will now correctly pierce enemies when Incendiary Shells are active

-Candy Jar
This item is now deprioritized by transaction stations that take random inputs from your inventory. You can now safely use them without worry of this item being taken unless it is the only viable input you have. [i]Candymaxxers rejoice![/i]

[h2]What's that sound?![/h2]
We are very excited to share that [i][b]Dylan King[/b][/i] has joined the Crystal Fruit Games team as a talented sound designer! He's got a fantastic youtube channel (linked below) and is an absolute CHEF when it comes to cooking up sound effects! The Commando is the first mercenary to have benefited from his [i]magic touch[/i], and we hope you like what you hear! Please note that some of his sounds are still works in progress and will be updated as we make more progress. Also be on the lookout for the new sounds for hitting and killing enemies, they're very juicy and satisfying! 

We've got exciting plans for all things audio in Minigunner, expect to hear more with each patch that is rolled out! 

[previewyoutube=E4OFSzq7in8;full][/previewyoutube][i]Subscribe to this man for yummy sound design breakdowns and insights![/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
If you want to report bugs or give feedback, join our [b][u][url=https://discord.gg/K7tfWk48qQ]Discord![/url][/u][/b]
If you want to check on the status of reported bugs, check out our [b][u][url=https://trello.com/b/1vwopl3b]Bug Tracker![/url][/u][/b]

These bugs have been squashed!

-Fixed issue where some enemies were not dealing correct damage while empowered

-Fixed some items have persistent effects after being scrapped or traded away

-Fixed having a button bound to interact meant opening a transaction station can instantly purchase or close

-Fixed an issue where Star Forger's Armor would not regenerate if you left a scene while it was coming back

-Fixed a visual issue with the Drillminer's light

-Fixed Halloween shop background for the Professional's Briefcase getting broken after a scene transition

-Fixed issue where the “low ammo” firing sound would play on the first shot after a reload

-Fixed an issue where readying the winchester shells right as entering a vent would break the shotgun

-Fixed issue where stacking the industrial capacitor would infinitely stun enemies

-Fixed issue where the Reactive Electro Goo would gain unintended stacking damage and stun time when changing scenes

-Fixed issue where changing scenes during a star forgers armor recharge would prevent the armor from being restored

-Fixed Candy Jar icon not reappearing on transaction stations with multiple uses

-Fixed an issue where stunned enemies could still get an attack off if they were about to fire

[h2]New Discord Emotes![/h2]
Say hello to the freshest batch of minigunner themed emojis on this side of Frostus III, now featuring the titular COMMANDO! (And friends!)

notes.title: The Pressing Matters Update
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.8.8.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

Hey everyone!

For this update we wanted to focus on quality of life features, tutorial improvements, and filling a gap in the item roster when it comes to reactor survivability, similar to how we improved the accessibility of area of effect items in the Luck of the Draw update. The goal is to give you more agency when it comes to reactor defense, and letting you make build decisions that have a noticeable payoff later on.

We're also adding a brand new transaction station to the underground: the Hydraulic Press!

Changes with the '📡 '  icon in front of them are changes or additions suggested by the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/175efa4346303756c7076f753a940a642fae3253.png[/img]
[h2]General[/h2]
-Added extra visual flair to getting legendary items from crates or transaction stations

-Improvements have been made to player movement to eliminate the jitteriness that would sometimes occur

-Updated mercenary descriptions in character select

-Improved reactor survivability: will now start repairing 50% sooner while at critical health

-Adjusted forklift art to improve clarity

-Updated the look of the Reactor's crystal

-Added some ground markings that call attention to the shop in the bottom right part of the map

-Scrap dropped by bosses will no longer despawn

-📡 Added a new option to auto mute the game when you alt+tab (on by default!)

-📡 Increased the attraction radius for non-scrap pick ups

-📡 Improved steam rich presence text to show more info about where you are in your run

-📡 "Games are better with friends!" (Engineer unlock achievement)
Unique sentry & drones requirement reduced 4 -> 3

-📡 Improved descriptions of all Crit Prism items to better describe what 'Crits' do

-📡 You can close the early access text in the main menu by pressing 'Esc'

-📡 Created a new asset pack for tier list icons! (Learn more at the end of this patch)

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
-Added a new first time player prompt that recommends doing the tutorial before starting a new game

-Added arrows to highlight new ui elements as they are revealed on screen

-Added arrows to highlight the doors on the TAB screen while they're being introduced

-Added arrows that emerge from active mineshafts to show where enemies will come from

-Camera will now zoom out to give you a better view of what is happening when the barricades are destroyed

-Improved guidance arrows for showing you the nearest shop or sentry spot

-Tweaked art assets in intro slide show sequence

-Added a typing sound to all dialogue boxes

-Streamlined the wording of many dialogue texts

-Various minor tweaks and improvements

[h2]Bosses[/h2]
-The Elder Spitter
Reduced max health by 18%

-The Giga-Beamer
Improved animation of attack 4's super giant beam to make it easier to tell when the beam is actually going to fire

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
-Improved consistency for enemies when they have multiple options to target. They will now always prioritize targets in this order: Safety Cone > Brigade Beamers > Player > Reactor

-Sniper
📡 Will now commit to any target they set their beam on. If the target they are aiming at dies or disappears, the attack will be reset.
[i]This change massively improves interactions where you are approaching a sniper while they are aiming at something else (like the reactor) only to be met by an untimely quick scope. Now they are much more susceptible to approaches and should be generally way more consistent to fight against![/i]

[h2]Transaction Stations[/h2]
[b]Sleeping Quarters[/b]
-Standard Unit Replacer
You can now cycle between 3 potential common item output choices!

[b]Laboratory [/b]
-Scientific Unit Replacer
You can now cycle between 2 potential rare item output choices!

[b]Mechanical Garage Room[/b]
-NEW: Hydraulic Press
Choose an item to destroy for maximum scrap (scales per threat level)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/5d933b963359e72dc9d31661e1e03b687cf72b8d.png[/img]
[h2]Sentries and Drones[/h2]
-All sentries have had their pick up speed increased by +20%

[h2]Items[/h2] 
-Red Matter Duplicator
Scrap interest percentage on wave end increased +12% -> +20%

-Cracked Pipe
Added new visuals for items that are discounted by this item!

-Charging Prism
Cooldown reduction on hit increased +10% -> +15%

-Energizing Battery
Cooldown reduction increased +20% -> +25%

-Cryo-Cola
Cooldown reduction increased +10% -> +15%
Movement speed increased +25% -> +30%

-Laser Pickaxe
Damage increased +80 -> +100

-Fusion Core
Kills required per level up decreased 10 -> 6

-Gilded Anvil (Engineer)
In addition to its existing effect, it will now also double your total overclock activation damage

-Gilded Anvil (Minigunner)
Powershot speed and range increased +20% -> +25%

-Fragile Monocle
Increased damage +35% -> +40%
Increased accuracy +8 degrees -> +10 degrees
Added a new visual that shows while you have this item!

-Irradiated Prism
OLD: 200 poison damage over 20 seconds 
NEW: 100 poison damage over 25 seconds 
The poison status effect can now be stacked repeatedly on a single enemy!
Updated poison VFX particles to increase in intensity as the target gets more poisened
[i]We are adjusting this item to allow for repeated hits to increase the strength of the poison damage to make this effect more distinct from afterburn. We had to adjust the numbers a bit to bring it more in line with the amplifying prism, as it can quickly surpass it in damage now! Poison is at its most effective against enemies that take longer to kill.[/i]

-Explosive Detonator
This item has been reworked! It will now grant a chance on kill for enemies to drop dynamite, use your ability to detonate it

[h2]New General Items[/h2] 
[i](spoilered for your protection)[/i]

[b]Common Tier[/b]
-Reactive Electro-Goo
[spoiler]The reactor gains a chance to block damage and fire a retaliatory bolt at the attacker [/spoiler]
[i]Unlocked by default![/i]

-Service Radio
[spoiler]Gain increased firerate and ability recharge speed whenever the reactor takes damage [/spoiler]
[i]Unlocked by default![/i]

-Industrial Capacitor
[spoiler]When the reactor takes damage it charges up a huge electric nova [/spoiler]
[i]Unlocked by default![/i]

notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.8.6.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

We hope you brought a sweater! The Frigid Frostblaster is here!! This boss features entirely new combat mechanics and some devastating ice-cold moves. We've also given defense drones a mini rework and have implemented steam cloud saving functionality!

[h2]General[/h2]
-NEW BOSS: The ☠️ [b]FRIGID FROSTBLASTER[/b] ☠️
This boss can be encountered in the third bossfight after defeating wave 12, and will be quite the formidable foe!

-New Arena Mechanic: [b]The Steam Release Valve[/b]
In the Frostblaster's chamber you can find a damaged Control Station that you can repair by spending some scrap. Once repaired you can interact with the big red valve to fill the room with superheated steam, and gain the [b]STEAMY[/b] buff!

-New Buff: [b]Steamy[/b] ♨️
This buff grants you increased movement speed and a [b]complete immunity to the frostbite debuff[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/bebdbbbfcb49e4679827b3603d36eeb6753ad309.png[/img]
-Speaking of Steam, we now have fully functional Steam Cloud Saving! Take your progress across multiple devices and leave those manual file transfers in the past!

-Updated the "Snowcone?" achievement
OLD: Kill a boss while you're afflicted with the frostbite debuff
NEW: Kill the Frostblaster without getting frostbite during the fight

-Updated the visuals of the frostbite debuff, with new particles, screen effects, and even freezing your weapon icon in the bottom left!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/3d39a838853fa7f46720077ba9a9f970302bdf44.png[/img]
[h2]Sentries & Drones[/h2]
-Defense Drone
Price scaling per defense drone purchased has been removed
Defense drones now take damage when they block projectiles, taking increased damage from more dangerous projectile types. 
Defense drones start regenerating health after not taking damage for a few seconds, if they take too much damage they explode, becoming disabled for a short while. 
Disabled defense drones will automatically repair and reenable at full health.
You can see the drone's current health level by the indicator light color and visual effects as more damage is taken. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496957/eccd0b1daec13ba0b5ec3096e611dbba32f078a7.png[/img][i]Developer Thoughts: Defense drones have always been held back by their old design. The first drone would be decently balanced, but because they could absorb infinite damage, each acquired drone would have exponential benefits, and as such several limitations had to be placed on the drones, such as the increasing price per defense drone purchased. The biggest flaw was how they limited the design of interesting enemy attacks that used a single projectile. With these adjustments, drones are much more healthy for the game, and should be easier to pick up as a result![/i]

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Whispering Lantern
Lanterns needed per level decreased 5 -> 3
Chance on kill for lantern to drop increased 3% -> 5%
Damage boost per level decreased +20% (Max +100%) -> +10% (Max +50%)
[i]The Whispering Lantern has been a very polarizing item, where it would be useless and slow to start stacking early on, but would become insanely too powerful late game. These changes aim to make it feel much more useful early on compared to before without becoming too powerful later. The buff from picking up lanterns once the item is fully stacked is still unchanged, and very strong. Now you should be able to stack this item faster and play for the powerful pickups as a reward.[/i]

-Juicy Co. Energy Drink
Increased firerate boost per stack +10% -> +15%

notes.title: The Drillminer Update
notes.content:
This patch marks the beginning of our work on the boss fights milestone!! We've added a new secret area where you can unlock a new playable mercenary: the Drillminer! He also comes with a whole set of achievements and items for him to unlock and use. The best part? You can now use this area to get a free legendary item in all of your runs (if you survive)!  

[h2]General[/h2]
-Added new secret area where you can complete the "Need a lift?" achievement, which unlocks the [i][b]Drillminer[/b][/i] as a playable character! 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2026092295926870211/4D663FBAED1FFB78D8BFEFD080D25B7A5ABE9E32/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

-This secret area also grants you a [i][b]guaranteed legendary item[/b][/i] if you complete the objective inside the room!
[i]NOTE: enemies in alternate areas will have significantly reduced scrap drop rates, making this an [b]optional[/b] high risk / high reward room. You will not miss out on a lot of scrap if you choose not to do it.[/i]

-The Drillminer has been updated with new lighting and new visual effects

-16 new Drillminer achievements are now available to unlock unique items for him

-Enemies now splatter on death!

-Reduced wave requirement for the Minigunner's "Not a scratch" achievement from wave 15 to wave 10

-Adjusted the Engineer's "Didn't lift a finger achievement" to be achievable on any high threat wave (wave 11 onwards)

-Updated doors and mineshaft entrances with new lighting effects

-Improved train functionality greatly, significantly reducing weird interactions related to it

[h2]Sentries and Drones[/h2]
-Decreased time needed to pick up sentries 1.5s -> 1s

-Decreased time needed to pick up the custom minisentry 0.75s -> 0.5s

-Decreased time needed to swap sentries 2s -> 1.25s

[h2]Minigunner[/h2]
-Minigun heat firerate multiplier reduced 0.3 -> 0.25
*we're reverting last patch's buff to compensate for an addition to the powershot's base functionality!*

-Powershot now grants you a +50% firerate boost for 3 seconds on kill!

notes.title: The Lighting Update
notes.content:
In this update we have completely overhauled the lighting in the game! We have put a tremendous amount of effort into using the lighting system to both improve visual polish as well as visual clarity when it comes to the gameplay. Enemies and enemy attacks now pop out much more than before and there has been a substantial improvement in tracking them in hectic moments when there's a lot going on, on screen. We've tried to be extra thorough with the application of the lighting to everything that needs it, but if something slipped through the cracks, be sure to let us know! We've also got a fun new item to help light your way!💡

[h2]General[/h2]
-Applied new lighting to the map, Mercenaries, enemies, and items!

-New SFX (WIP)

 [h2]New General Items[/h2]   [i](spoilered for your protection)[/i]

[b]Common Tier [/b]
-Heavy-Duty Flashlight 🔦 
[spoiler]Chance to gain a massive firerate boost after killing a large enemy[/spoiler]

notes.title: The Map Update
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the biggest update we've pushed so far! [/h2]

We have completely overhauled the art of the map, shops and teleporters! The map has also gotten a major layout adjustment, the center of the map now has tracks that freight trains will pass through on, squashing everything in their paths! We have also reworked the screwdriver's functionality to help fully realize its fantasy, as the ultimate utility movement item! Lastly we have a handful of balance improvements to waves and enemies, as well as a new batch of exciting items!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1904485941123160035/286422C996CFA808ACF56AF1B86F404F0A4968A6/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

This update marks the start of our alpha phase! Feel free to join our [b][url=discord.gg/7xGuWR2HnU]discord server[/url][/b], where you can give feedback on anything related to the game! We're also posting daily updates on what we're working on so come and hang out it if you're interested!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1904485941123157550/A57A3C17576D6501B2CD1E68276306216422711E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]
-Updated the layout and art of the map!
•There is now a new alternate path in the middle of the map that enemies can take

-New map hazard/ diversion: [b]FREIGHT TRAINS[/b]
•These trains can vary in size and length, with some that pass through the map for the whole duration of a wave!
•The lights on the tracks will warn you when a train is incoming, be sure to stand clear! 
•The train will [b]instantly kill[/b] all enemies it runs over when it enters the map
•When a long train is passing, enemies are diverted down the new alternate path

-Updated the look of shop terminals and teleporter entrances

-Combat roll travel speed increased by 5%

-New spooky visuals in the shop! 🎃 

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
-Decreased the difficult spike of waves 11 and 16, now there shouldn't be as overwhelming numbers of Bombers, Executioners, Detonators, and Freezers.

-Slightly increased the scaling difficulty from waves 17-19 to be more impactful

-Some enemies have had their attack projectile speed decreased and now take slightly longer to charge up their shots

[h2]Minigunner[/h2]
-Minigun starting ammo increased 32 -> 40
[i]Extended Magazine now grants the minigun +10 ammo, Ammonite now grants +4 ammo and Heavy Shopper now grants +4 ammo[/i]

-Powershot cast self slow decreased 70% -> 50%

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Forgotten Screwdriver
New Effect: you can press E to interact with vents to hop into one and open up a map of the outpost. From here you can select ANY other vent to fast travel to and hop out of, granting you a short speed boost when you exit
[i]The placement of vents throughout the map has also been updated[/i]

-Brittle Shield
Immunity duration after this item triggers increased 4s -> 8s

-Remote Detonator
Explosion damage increased 75 -> 100
Dynamite dropped per roll now scales with more stacks of this item

 [h2]New General Items[/h2]   [i](spoilered for your protection)[/i]

[b]Common Tier [/b]
-Excited Prism ✨ 
[spoiler]Increased crit chance. Your crits now grant you a firerate boost on hit.[/spoiler]

-Charging Prism ⚡ 
[spoiler]Increased crit chance. Your crits now grant you a cooldown refund on hit.[/spoiler]

[b]Rare Tier [/b]
-Irradiated Prism ☢️ 
[spoiler]Increased crit chance. Your crits now poison enemies hit.[/spoiler]

-Luminescent Prism 🌟 
[spoiler]Increased crit chance. Your crits now stun enemies hit.[/spoiler]

[b]Legendary Tier [/b]
-Whispering Lantern 👻 
[spoiler]Large enemies now have a chance to drop lanterns that permanently increase your damage when picked up.[/spoiler]
[i]take the lantern...[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Fixed the inventory being hidden under the background after you win

-Fixed numerous smaller bugs

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]
We're super excited to finally start our game's alpha! Our next updates should include the Drillminer and all his achievements and unlocks, so keep an eye out for that! In the meantime, have fun and have a great Halloween! :)

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1904485941123271821/F7862074EFD5CF9FF778DD5BCF5CB829BF08D949/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

notes.title: 0.7.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.7.8.1 Patch Notes[/h1]

This is a small patch that has some fixes and improvements, and is mostly preparation for upcoming larger updates.

[h2]General[/h2]
[b]-Updated Main Menu [/b]
•NEW: Community Button, check out our latest news and links to our social media channels
•NEW: Kickstarter Button: Direct link to our active Kickstarter!

[b]-Improvements to controller support [/b]
•NEW: You can now toggle on and adjust an aim assist feature!
•Controller movement is no longer restricted to 8 directions of movement, this should be much smoother now

-Increased the size of enemy projectiles and attacks, but not the hitbox! Now they are much easier to see in hectic situations and this helps minimize those "what hit me moments". This also makes getting hit by enemy attack feel a lot more fair, as now bullets that barely graze you don't count as hits.

-Cleaned up some messy particle and visual effects to help with visual noise when you are in late game fights

-The small minimap now shows door status and active enemy spawnpoints!

-Some achievements have been updated to make them a bit easier to get

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Explosive Detonator
Dynamite drop condition changed from "chance on kill" to "on combat roll". 
[i]Now you have much more control over the placement of the dynamite and setting up traps is way more consistent.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Minor bug fixing

notes.title: The Permanent Progression Update
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner 0.7.8 Patch Notes[/h1]

Hey everyone! We're proud to announce that our achievement and permanent progression update is here, concluding the current milestone! [b]The 'Unlocks' page on the TAB screen is now fully functional[/b]! From here you can browse and track progress towards achievements from 3 major categories: general, mercenary unlock, and class specific. [b]Each achievement is tied to a special reward[/b] to be unlocked, such as items, difficulties, and new playable mercenaries. From this point going forward all new content we add will now be attainable in this way! 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1916863994973668326/342FE6471F9CD59AF3150B82D402894DDA9BDF14/?imw=1920&&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

In this update you should be able to unlock all difficulty settings, general items, Minigunner items, and the Engineer and his items. The Drillminer is temporarily unattainable and will be unlockable through a new [i][b]secret area[/b][/i] that is still under construction, so be on the lookout for that in the near future!

With that being said, Our [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crystalfruitgames/minigunner]Kickstarter[/url][/b] is launching just over 2 weeks from now, and we're gonna be hard at work preparing for that! Expect more dev updates along the way! 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1916863994973329348/19A1CB2500948C3ADC71EA1FE7C8F8D9709B152B/?imw=1024&&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]
[b]-Unlocks screen is now functional! [/b]
•Keep track of your achievement progress in real time
•Each achievement has a unique reward
•Work towards unlocking items, difficulties, and mercenaries

-32 New general achievements

-1 New mercenary unlock achievement

-14 New Minigunner achievements

-15 New Engineer achievements

-Some sound effects have been updated/ adjusted

-The shop now has a friendly shop keeper AI

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Heavy Caliber Rounds
Increased projectile knockback +75% -> +100%
Increased projectile size 50% -> 75%
[i]Projectile size is now unaffected by getting more stacks[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Fixed combat roll cooldown not being displayed properly on stats screen

-Fixed numerous smaller bugs

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]
We've tried really hard to squash every bug that has come up with these new achievements, but if you find one, please let us know! We also wanted to mention that there are some achievements that refer to bosses/ boss fights, these are temporarily unattainable as this content isn't in the game yet, but this will be the focus as we start our new roadmap milestone: the [b]boss fight update[/b]. 

We also wanted to mention the we created a [b]new subreddit for our game[/b]! Feel free to join the sub to get dev updates and sneak peaks at upcoming content for Minigunner!
[h3][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Minigunner/]r/Minigunner[/url][/h3]

notes.title: 0.7.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.7.7 Patch Notes[/h1]

We're almost done with the new TAB screen pages!  The [b]equipment page[/b] now works and the [b]inventory page[/b] got a much needed facelift. Now there should be much more clarity on exactly what each of your items is doing and how they stack. The equipment page adds some new customization options for your sentries and drones that we think you'll enjoy! Now that all of these screens are working, we are on to our final challenge for the milestone: [b]achievements and item unlocks[/b]!

[h2]General[/h2]
[b]-Updated Inventory screen! [/b]
•Items now have improved descriptions
•Items now clearly show which attributes stack and how
•You can now see and track live stats for each item

[b]-Equipment screen is now functional! [/b]
•Keep track of your sentries and drones
•Check their stats in real time
•You can now toggle between 4 targeting modes for your sentries
•Rename sentries and drones to make them your own!

[b]-Minor wave rebalancing: [/b]
•Early waves should spawn enemies a little bit quicker at the start
•The first wave of each difficulty tier will now have increased spawn chances for the new enemies of that tier

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Cracked Pipe, Safety Compliance, and Heavy Shopper now apply their effects as soon as you buy them (instead of needing to wait for the next shop)

-Updated how cooldown reduction works, now recharge items scale hyperbolically
[i](previously we used a convoluted system of adding flat cooldown reduction but cutting it in half, now we use a standard exponential formula!)[/i]

-Refracting Fragments and Jarred Lightning now drop similarly to Scavenging Claw's scrap drops, they each have a flat percent chance now. 
[i](previously they were in the same drop pool as enemy scrap drops, and would only drop if the enemy was to drop more than one scrap on death.. very weird system that we don't have to worry about anymore!)[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Fixed some items not stacking properly

-Fixed a wave number bug on the TAB screen 

-Fixed numerous smaller bugs

notes.title: 0.7.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.7.6 Patch Notes[/h1]

Small patch that addresses some bugs and improvements that have come up. We have made great progress on the save data stuff, and now the game over screen actually works again! We've also got quite a few minor/ QoL changes and the addition of some sweet new engineer sound effects!

[h2]General[/h2]
-Game Over screen now functional (finally!)

-Gain points and set records for making it further in the game, adding up to a total score!
(point multipliers and new records are subject to change, this is our initial implementation, let us know what you think!)

-The 'Stats' page on your TAB screen is now functional as well! Check out all your weapon, ability, player, and mission stats as they update throughout the game!

-Improved some tutorial dialogue to better explain gameplay and mechanics

-New batch of SFX is in! The engineer has some very juicy sounds now! (Some of these will be tweaked a little but the shotgun and overclock sounds are so cool)

-All 'block' effects now give you 1 second of immunity after they trigger, and these effects now won't trigger while you're already immune

-Damaging an enemy that still has spawn immunity will now show an "immune" damage text

-Updated ability and combat roll cooldown ui

-Silver Wings, and Royal Jelly have updated visual effects!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Fixed the pickaxe being broken with controllers unless you moved your mouse

-Fixed easy mode actually reducing reactor repair speed instead of speeding it up (lol)

-Fixed enemies not taking the new spawn locations when barricades would break in the tutorial

-Fixed a bug where if you would start the wave with the bridge up, enemies would be unable to path through it even when it came back down

-Fixed not being able to open the pause menu while in tutorial intro sequence

notes.title: Minigunner Build 0.7.5.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch brings some QoL and balance improvements to the Minigunner and the early game difficulty. Our aim with these changes is to bring the minigunner up to the same level as the other two mercenaries, and to help alleviate his dependence on certain key items in the early game, which should lower the barrier to entry for new players.

[b]General[/b]
-Slightly reduced difficulty of waves 3, 4, and 5

-Now when you gain any ammo while reloading, it will speed up your reload by the % of your max ammo refunded, instead of it going into your clip

-Fixed some bugs with the tutorial

-The time it takes for the reactor to start healing after taking damage has been reduced 5 seconds -> 4 seconds

-Base scrap attraction range increased by +5%

-For controllers: increased minimum stick deadzone

[b]Minigunner[/b]
-Minigun firerate increased by +6%

-Firerate granted per heat level increased +15% -> +20%

-Powershot ammo refund on kill increased 50% max ammo -> 100% max ammo

-Powershot range increased by +11%

-Powershot cooldown increased 6 seconds -> 7 seconds

[b]Items[/b]
-Bandit's Bandolier
New Effect: [spoiler]Powershot's main projectile now pierces and marks enemies hit as vulnerable[/spoiler]

notes.title: 0.7.5.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Minigunner Build 0.7.5.3 Patch Notes[/h1]

Hey everyone! This patch brings an [b]updated tutorial[/b], new [b]intro sequence[/b], [b]QoL improvements[/b], and a bunch of [b]new SFX[/b]! This is the patch that we are going to use to showcase our game to content creators, critics, websites, journalists and more, we've done our best to fix any outstanding bugs and apply extra polish here and there, but be sure to let us know if you find anything that slipped through the cracks. This patch also concludes our current 'tutorial update' roadmap milestone! We are very excited to start work on the next one, and with that, our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crystalfruitgames/minigunner]kickstarter[/url] launch is right around the corner... 

[h2]General[/h2]
-Updated tutorial to do a better job of teaching new players the essentials

-Added visual feedback to things that go boom! 

-Combat Roll 
cooldown reduced 1.25s -> 1s

-Minigun 
base firerate increased by +4%

-New batch of SFX has been implemented (all feedback is welcome!)

[h2]Sentries & Drones[/h2]
-Attack drones have significantly increased rotation speed, they can now track moving targets much better, as well as acquire new targets much faster!

-You can now pick up and move your sentries during the wave! (the mini sentry now also has a +50% quicker pick up speed too!)

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
-Slightly increased attack charge time for spitters and splitters

-New satisfying particle effects for when enemies die

-Improvements have been made to the enemies' pathing, leading to much fewer "famous guy" moments, as well as less questionable pathing decisions being made by the gloops..

[h2]Items[/h2]
-Steam Boots 
movement speed increased +16% -> +20%
